steps.d: In Courses, press New course and fill in the title, descriptions, price and banner.
In the Content tab, add modules for each chapter or week, with an opening day if you want one.
Add videos, PDFs, tests or live classes to each module from your library, or upload new.
Upload to AllCoaching for a protected, watermarked player, or use your own YouTube.
Set release dates in the Schedule tab, then publish and share the course page.

faq.q: How do I create an online course?
faq.a: In Courses, press New course, fill in the title, descriptions, price and banner, then Save draft or Create course. Then add modules and lessons in the course’s Content tab.

faq.q: How do I set the course price and GST?
faq.a: Choose Paid or Free, enter your price and, if you like, an MRP that is shown struck through. A switch adds 18% GST on top for the student, and the form shows what the student pays and what you receive on each sale.

faq.q: How do I protect my course videos?
faq.a: Videos uploaded to AllCoaching play in a DRM-protected player, with each student’s name as a watermark while they watch and your logo on the video. DRM and watermarking are part of every plan.

faq.q: How do I add YouTube videos to my course?
faq.a: Connect My YouTube to upload straight to your channel as unlisted, or paste a YouTube link for a video already there. A YouTube video can also be opened outside your course, so for paid lessons an AllCoaching upload is the safer choice.

faq.q: Do students get a certificate when they finish?
faq.a: Yes. Certificates carry your branding, are issued automatically when a student completes the course and each has a unique ID. Students can download and share them; a certificate is a proof of completion, not an accredited degree.
